title: XOR with a zero block
statement: For natural numbers $a$, $k$, and $i$, and a bit string $z$, let $m=a(|\pi_1(z)|+1)^k$, where $\pi_1(z)$ is the total first projection of $z$. The bitwise XOR of the length-$m$ zero word with the length-$m$ block beginning at position $im$ in the total second projection of $z$ equals that block.
